name: TypeIndexList
job: An oversized typographic index of names (projects, services, collections) where the focused row opens a full-bleed slot that prints its image in cobalt ink, while the other names stay as outlines
visitor_action: hover, focus (arrow keys) or tap a row to open its slot; click follows its link (on touch the first tap previews, the second opens)
mobile: same slot behind the tapped row; labels drop under the name
motion: the cobalt slot squeegees to the focused row (leading edge lands first, trailing edge drags), the name wipes in white, the print crossfades and pans; pointer shears the outline letters in 3D (reduced-motion: instant, no tilt)
art_direction: Print studio index: cool concrete grey page, Big Shoulders condensed caps, one cobalt ink that bleeds edge to edge through the focused row as a duotone print, hairline dividers
